name: ToastyReplay-Lite
description: A lightweight version of ToastyReplay with a native Geometry Dash interface.

disable-input-precision.name: Disable CBF/CBS While Recording
disable-input-precision.description: Turn off Click Between Frames and Click Between Steps while recording or playing a replay, then restore them afterward.

watermark.name: Watermark
watermark.description: Show the ToastyReplay Lite logo and version in the corner while the menu is open or a macro is recording or playing.

show-floating-button.name: Show Floating Button
show-floating-button.description: Shows a floating button you can drag around to quickly open the menu. Designed for mobile users
